counting_rule: Candidate components Absentee, Election Day and Early Voting are summed exactly once. Total Votes is accepted only as a standalone candidate total; overlapping, duplicate, missing or unknown components fail validation. Statewide summaries, nested precincts and turnout are excluded. Party names come from metadata PartyID lookups, not candidate-name heuristics.
memory_rule: JSON on_load removes nested Locations from county objects and releases unsupported local-contest objects. Complete JSON syntax is still validated.
metadata_rule: The raw ElectionID must exactly equal both metadata election IDs. Current general-election date/name, county FIPS/name and vote-type descriptions must match. Config advertises passwordRequired=false.
limitations: First sample is an official zero scaffold, not evidence of later live update reliability.
No matched historical baseline added for Arkansas.
Timestamp is the companion election-info lastUpdated, archived alongside raw export.
If both aggregate and named write-in choices appear, adapter fails rather than double-counting them.
verification: Four focused tests / 16 assertions pass; real current file parsed to 153 county/race units; RuboCop clean.
